column1: # One row per tool + format + compress-level + threads we qualify and time.
# Compression rows use the tool's native level scale. Decode-only tools have
# one row with level -. Decode-only peers can be streaming or full-buffer;
# coverage.tsv records the decode mode. Never rank those modes together.
# All rows here are ST. Do not add pigz -p32, igzip -T, or pigz -11.
# tier: prime (daily work), extended (wider context), all (publication runs).
# lane: fast, balanced, dense marks the three representative levels per tool
#   (--levels lanes, the default); - is used only by --levels all. Decode rows
#   use lane -. igzip lanes follow tmp/gzip/compress/PEER-MAPPING.md; libdeflate
#   1/6/12 (fastest, default, densest) is provisional until its frontier is measured.
